events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, 'The Beatles', widely known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their iconic 'White Album'. Which track from the double LP is still on your playlist?

events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: November 24th marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His incredible voice and showmanship left an indelible mark on music.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh as ever, doesn't it?

events.title: Tribute to John Lennon

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
